description: Change name, age, date, times, place, address, notes or wish list link. Only given fields change. Needs the party edit link.

address.description: Full address, shown to a guest only after they said yes (optional).

child_name.description: First name of the birthday child.

date.description: Party day as YYYY-MM-DD, today up to one year ahead.

edit_link.description: The secret party edit link (https://www.mapumi.de/einladung/e/…) or just its key.

notes.description: Notes for the parents of the guests, e.g. pickup time, what to bring (optional).

place.description: Where, shown to all guests, e.g. "bei uns zu Hause" (optional).

wishlist_link.description: Share link of the child's wish list (https://wunschzettel.mapumi.de/z/…), optional. Empty string removes it.

name: update_party
title: Change party details
